blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – No bettor won the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Lotto 6/42 jackpots in Saturday’s draws, Nov. 28, 2026, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw yielded the winning combination 16-28-18-29-39-31, with a jackpot of ₱45.18 million. No ticket matched all six winning numbers. READ: Lotto Results Today – November 28, 2026 Meanwhile, the Lotto 6/42 winning combination was 29-38-28-05-31-19, with a jackpot of ₱13.95 million. No bettor won the top prize.
